description:
The TimescaleDB adapter (benchbox/platforms/timescaledb.py) uses f-string interpolation
to construct SQL queries with user-controlled values, creating SQL injection vulnerabilities.

Identified in code review on 2025-12-24 (commit e58ed40e).

Affected locations:
- Lines 300-310: create_hypertable() with chunk_interval parameter
- Lines 362-380: add_compression_policy() with compression_after parameter
- Line 410: ANALYZE with qualified_table

Example vulnerable code:
```python
cursor.execute(f"""
    SELECT create_hypertable(
        '{qualified_table}',  # table_name from config
        'time',
        chunk_time_interval => INTERVAL '{self.chunk_interval}',  # user-controlled!
        ...
    )
""")
```

If chunk_interval contains `'; DROP TABLE users; --`, it could execute arbitrary SQL.
